conclusion.family: The 31 distinct-prime tiles whose exact subgroup orders divide 5040.
conclusion.scope: No choice of one affine shift for each of these 31 tiles covers Z^2.

nonclaims: This does not exclude a cover using tiles outside the n-divides-5040 family.
This does not prove that Erdős problem 203 has a negative answer.
This producer analysis is not a separately scoped Verification or human Decision.
No scientific Standing changes from this artifact.

proof.cover_upper_bound: A cover would make the fixed pair mass at most (271/23)(3/140) = 813/3220.
proof.density_identity: If the selected tiles covered the torus, the expected excess multiplicity E[r-1] would equal 143/140 - 1 = 3/140.
proof.fixed_pair_mass: For 271 tile pairs the exact compatibility index is one, so every shift pair intersects with density 1/(n_i n_j). Their fixed total pair-intersection mass is 420493/1270080.
proof.pointwise_bound: For any nonempty set of r among 31 covering tiles, its number of mandatory-overlap edges is at most min(r(r-1)/2,271), which is at most (271/23)(r-1); the maximum occurs at r=24.
